where_you_are: Sir Phidipaldi is at the bar of the empty Golden Egg Tavern with its owner, Quinn. Wayman Tisdale and Dr. Uriah are across the street in the Clumsy Fox Tavern, where Bentley has let them stay. Dunk is at Farmer Gill's farm, drinking with a very drunk Gill on the porch before bedding down in the barn.
